slides.prompt:
Create ONE original Lightweight fitness photo-carousel slide, portrait 1080 x 1350 pixels (4:5). Reference 1 is the authoritative CLEAN background: a completely solid opaque flat #F0F1EB canvas. Reference 2 is ONLY a layout/type/illustration reference. Ignore and entirely omit its old arch and any progress bars. NO ARCH, no pale curve, no blob, no rings, no grid, no dots, no gradient, no texture, no checkerboard, no transparency, no progress meter and no slide counter. The background must be plain opaque #F0F1EB over every pixel behind the content. Export opaque RGB PNG, no alpha.

Series palette: coral #F26445; text dark #2A2A2A; body grey #6B6B6B; white #FFFFFF; anatomy warm sand #D9CBBE with darker sand shading, ivory skin/tendons about #F5F0E5; fine grey anatomical linework. No green/sage on figures. Rubik for all typography: heaviest cover, bold titles/pills/target values, regular body. Match the premium clean series rendering, line weights, type hierarchy and generous spacing.

Mannequin when present: adult male, bald, faceless smooth plastic anatomy mannequin with a smooth featureless pelvis and no genital detail; plain opaque short shorts in sand #D9CBBE, fine anatomical muscle lines, athletic natural proportions, sand and ivory. Lats and biceps coral on each pulling figure. Same recognizable mannequin and simple realistic black pull-up apparatus through all six levels.

Reserve x30–330,y20–103 completely empty off-white for the actual supplied Lightweight wordmark, inserted as original pixels in final assembly at x40,y28. Do NOT generate, invent, redraw or imitate a logo. No extra words, punctuation, signature, caption, watermark or decorations beyond those explicitly requested. All text fully visible, never overlapped by an illustration or cropped by an edge. Keep exact capitalization, hyphens, apostrophes and punctuation. Do not rewrite copy.

COVER: Follow reference 2's two stacked huge headline lines, soft grey offset shadow and lower anatomical illustration. The two lines MUST be exactly CAN'T DO in dark and A PULL-UP? in coral. Use heaviest Rubik; fit both whole lines inside 60 px left/right margins, no extra line breaks. Center headline in the upper 40%, around y155–510, scaled for its longer copy. Below: rear view of the anatomical man hanging from a simple black overhead pull-up bar, overhand grip, both arms fully straight overhead, head tilted up toward the bar. Lats highlighted coral, all other muscles sand/ivory. Black bar horizontally above the hands, natural hanging body with sand shorts, lower body may crop at bottom. Keep the bar/figure below the headline, with no text overlap. No splat or extra ornament. Only the two requested headline lines.

Exact allowed copy, no additional words:
CAN'T DO
A PULL-UP?
